youtube.title: Why Shop Receipts Fade Over Time 🧾 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Thermal paper receipts have no ink. The paper is coated with a dye and a developer that react when the printer head heats them, turning the spot black. Over time heat, light and friction cause the same coating to fade, so the printed text disappears.
